description:
Native Dataset Card documenting a simulation trace or synthetic training dataset.

Conforms to Datasheets for Datasets (Gebru et al., arXiv:1803.09010).

artifact_fingerprint.description: Canonical cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprint of the described artifact.
artifact_fingerprint.title: Artifact Fingerprint

biases_and_limitations.description: Sampling biases, distribution coverage limits, or simulator artifacts.
biases_and_limitations.title: Biases And Limitations

collection_process.default: Monte Carlo simulation rollout under EWM Engine
collection_process.description: Methodology and generator configuration used to assemble dataset.
collection_process.title: Collection Process

description.description: Description of generated trajectories, entities, and systemic traces.
description.title: Description

features.description: List of recorded feature fields, resource timeseries, and state attributes.
features.title: Features

intended_use.description: Intended downstream tasks (e.g. offline policy evaluation, dynamics learning).
intended_use.title: Intended Use

num_steps.description: Total discrete simulation steps across all trajectories.
num_steps.title: Num Steps

num_trajectories.description: Total rollout trajectories contained in dataset.
num_trajectories.title: Num Trajectories

provenance_fingerprints.description: Upstream world state and scenario fingerprints from which this dataset was generated.
provenance_fingerprints.title: Provenance Fingerprints

title: DatasetCard
